qualifications: Production can retain editable weak-outline proposals, while this palette adapter rejects unsupported silhouettes. Compare 8 versus 0 strongly supported real crops separately from 28 versus 0 proposals.
Only the seven previously unresolved real cases were selected for fitting; other production proposals were not refitted in this replay. No new full 31-case solver success rate is claimed.

The synthetic pipeline diagnostic uses 12 identity-selected v0 views (four each from development, recipe validation, recipe test), not all 256 recipe-held-out views. Dense segmentation metrics score every held-out view.
Eleven checked pairs per method are a conditional comparison: errors are scored only on the observed portion of the true overlap. Observed fractions and all missing-crop cases remain recorded.
Known geometry is used only in synthetic supervision and labeled oracle/scoring controls. Real photos never enter training, initialization selection, threshold selection or checkpoint selection.
Near-perfect synthetic segmentation did not establish real-photo generalization; the application is unchanged.
